name: The Only Prescription
label: Quest
description: The Only Prescription: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I should have known. My arch-enemy, Doctor Weavil, up to his old tricks! And now, thanks to your failure in Winterspring, Doctor Weavil has destroyed my book! How are you going to save the world now, hero?

The note I received stated that the only known copy of "Draconic for Dummies: Volume II" was ripped into 8 parts and scattered to the wind! If you somehow manage to find those missing chapters, use this magical binding to put them back together and return to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I put my pants on just like you - one leg at a time. Except when my pants are on, I make arcanite buoys. Arcanite buoys, baby!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Fantastic! I can't believe you went through the hassle! Are you some kind of machine? If it were me, I would have probably just let the world implode.
I tip my turban to you, sir. And no good deed should go unrewarded.
